faqs.q: Can I link Axis SUPERMONEY Credit Card to any UPI app?
faqs.a: Yes, Axis Bank SUPERMONEY card can be linked to any UPI app of your choice like all other RuPay credit cards.

faqs.q: Will Axis Bank SUPERMONEY Credit Card give 3% cashback on UPI apps like GPay, PhonePe and Paytm?
faqs.a: Axis Bank SUPERMONEY RuPay Credit Card offers 3% cashback only on UPI transactions made through super.money app. UPI payments made using all other UPI apps will only earn 1% cashback.

faqs.q: Is there any capping on cashback on Axis Bank SUPERMONEY Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, you can only earn cashback worth up to Rs. 500 every month through Axis SUPER MONEY Credit Card.

faqs.q: Are there any fees or charges associated with super.money app usage?
faqs.a: No, you do not have to pay any fee to create your account on super.money or to use the app to make your payments.
